chapters.name: Accidental Witness
chapters.summary: Kozlov, Anastasia, Skier and Reshala. Ends with the incriminating audio tape in a Shoreline flower bed — major evidence 1 of 9.
chapters.howToStart: White scribbled-on car in the courtyard between Customs dorms.

steps.title: Find the scribbled-on car between Customs dorms
steps.detail: White sedan covered in writing, courtyard of the two-storey and three-storey dorms. Walking up to it starts the chapter.

steps.title: Kozlov lived in dorm 110 — read the note on the door
steps.detail: First floor of the two-storey dorms. Note for Kozlov is on the wall just below the room number.

steps.title: Enter room 110 and read the letter on the nightstand
steps.detail: Needs the Dorm room 110 key. Read the letter on the nightstand. Optional: Note from the repair shop on the kitchen wall next to room 110.
steps.location: Two-storey dorms, room 110, first floor — letter on the nightstand

steps.title: Ask Skier about Anastasia
steps.detail: Trader screen. He points you at his accomplice's apartment.

steps.title: Streets: Zmeisky 3 apartment 7 — read four documents
steps.detail: First floor of Zmeisky 3, backyard entrance, Streets. Needs the Zmeisky 3 apartment key. Four items, each with several spawns: Ninth Circle #19 (living-room walls), Tarkov Herald summary (shelf by the TV, armchair, or bookshelf), FSB report (TV drawer or windowsill), Ninth Circle #14 (kitchen wall). Extract Streets Survived or Run-Through.

steps.title: Report to Skier, then talk to Ragman
steps.detail: Both through the trader screen.

steps.title: Locate Anastasia's apartment, then the mailbox
steps.detail: Chekannaya 13, second floor, Streets. Go back down and read the letter and Tarkov Herald newspaper in the building mailbox.

steps.title: Courier Pasha's ambush — note by the bicycle
steps.detail: Next to the two-storey dorms on Customs. Unsealed envelope beside the bike. Then talk to Skier again.

steps.title: Search Reshala's bunkhouse on Customs
steps.detail: Bunkhouse on Customs. Needs Reshala's bunkhouse key. Read three notes inside: Reshala's work notes and courier Pasha's belongings are among them. Optional: kill Reshala for the key if you do not already have it.

steps.title: MAJOR EVIDENCE: audio tape in the Shoreline flower bed
steps.detail: Kozlov's hideout is house no. 3, eastern west-village on Shoreline. Tape is in the flower bed by the entrance — pick it up and listen. Optional newspaper clipping is on the floor inside.

chapters.name: Batya
chapters.summary: The Bogatyr BEAR squad. Ends with the agent network deployment report on a red crate at Lightkeeper — major evidence 2 of 9. Needs Intelligence Center 3.
chapters.howToStart: Bogatyr patch: Customs power-station sofa, Woods BRDM, Reserve white-king roof, or Lighthouse BEAR-camp stump.

steps.title: Pick up and read a Bogatyr patch
steps.detail: Pick up and read a Bogatyr squad patch. One spawn is the couch in the cabin on the hill south-west of New Gas on Customs. Other spawns are on Woods, Reserve and Lighthouse.
steps.location: Cabin on the hill south-west of New Gas on Customs, plus other Bogatyr patch spawns

steps.title: Ask Jaeger about the BEAR patch
steps.detail: Trader screen.

steps.title: Woods: Ryabina outpost north of the sawmill
steps.detail: Read Hostage evacuation report from Voevoda on a pallet. Strelets' amulet is on a green crate at the sniper nest — move it to off-raid quest inventory.

steps.title: Interchange: Carousel outpost opposite IDEA checkout
steps.detail: Inside ULTRA. Pick up Taran's postcard and personal file, Voevoda's recorder and tape, Voevoda's and Strelets' files upstairs. Strelets' note has radio code 27.893.2000. Move postcard and recorder to off-raid quest inventory.

steps.title: Interchange: Gnezdo outpost east of ULTRA
steps.detail: Tent and rock camp. Audio tape on the radio, Moreman's file on a bed, triangulated-signal map in a sleeping bag, operations report by the guitar, first radio-code note on a pallet.

steps.title: Woods: Moreman's grave near ZB-016
steps.detail: Second radio-code note in a boot, Moreman's phone by the cross, dogtag on the sleeping bag. The two code notes together are frequency 35.70. Move phone and dogtag off-raid.

steps.title: Craft and listen to Moreman's tapes at Workbench 1
steps.detail: Two crafts, ~12 hours each. Hideout power must stay on or the craft dies.

steps.title: Build Intelligence Center 3, then radio the squad
steps.detail: Frequency 35.70, then code 27.893.2000 from Strelets' note.

steps.title: Unlock Lightkeeper and hand over the five Bogatyr keepsakes
steps.detail: Mechanic's Network Provider chain + encoded DSP transmitter. Do not harm Zryachiy. Hand Taran's postcard, Voevoda's recorder, Strelets' amulet, Moreman's dogtag and the Bogatyr patch (move them into in-raid quest inventory first).

steps.title: Wait 6–12h, radio Voevoda, finish his skill and kill tasks
steps.detail: LMG 5, AR 10, Stress Resistance 10, Strength 15, 15 kills without dying, 4 PMC kills without dying. Radio again at 35.70 / 27.893.2000.

steps.title: Note on Prapor at the Lighthouse BEAR camp, then interrogate Prapor
steps.detail: Note on a metal pole. Then trader screen.

steps.title: Cultist mark: Shoreline island photo, or Woods/Customs marked-room note
steps.detail: Voevoda's photo with a cultist mark is on the floor of the Shoreline island house. Note mentioning General: marked circle west of Woods sawmill, or dorm 314 marked room on Customs.

steps.title: MAJOR EVIDENCE: agent network report on Lightkeeper's red crate
steps.detail: Talk to Lightkeeper, wait 6 hours, return to his locked area and read the Agent network deployment report on a red wooden box.

chapters.name: Blue Fire
chapters.summary: The EMP and Object 1156. Ends with the Item #1156 specification in the Streets Rus Post van — major evidence 3 of 9.
chapters.howToStart: EMERCOM leaflet: green container at Woods Scav-base camp, Interchange highway tents, ULTRA medical unit, or Labyrinth prototype table.

steps.title: Read an EMERCOM leaflet to start the chapter
steps.detail: Read an EMERCOM leaflet. One spawn is the tent west of the highway near Path to River on Interchange. Others are on Woods and in the Labyrinth. Reading any one starts the chapter.
steps.location: Tent west of the highway near Path to River on Interchange, or the other EMERCOM leaflet spawns

steps.title: Talk to Mechanic about the EMP blast
steps.detail: Trader screen.

steps.title: Find a device fragment and hand it to Mechanic
steps.detail: Unknown device fragment. Either the closed section on the second floor of LexOs (Car dealership closed section key — the lot is mined with claymores) or the marked room in Chekannaya 13 (Mysterious room marked key). Only one spawn is required. Hand it to Mechanic.
steps.location: LexOs closed section (2nd floor) or Chekannaya 13 marked room

steps.title: Plant the local-network hacking device in Labs server room
steps.detail: First floor, next to the office chairs. Mechanic mails one. Auto-completes if you already planted it for Boreas.

steps.title: Keep the 1156 fragment, or sell it to Mechanic for 1.5M
steps.detail: Keeping it unlocks Better Served. Selling it is cash. Does not change the ending.

steps.title: Find a lead on Item 1156
steps.detail: Note mentioning Item #1156: Ground Zero TG office 4 (level 21+, science office key); northern blue chalet bookshelf on Lighthouse; or Labs office O22 desk.

steps.title: Streets Rus Post: listen to three audio tapes
steps.detail: Needs an audio recorder. Tape 1: desk with the screen behind the counter. Tape 2: on the coffee machine by storage. Tape 3: back-office desk through the hallway.

steps.title: MAJOR EVIDENCE: Item #1156 spec in the Rus Post van
steps.detail: Rus Post car key spawns every raid by the back-right wheel. The van is parked in front of the post office. Spec is in the back — read it. Unlocks Inferno.

chapters.name: Boreas
chapters.summary: Paradigm Shipping and the icebreaker. Ends with Icebreaker archive data in the mail after decoding the drives — major evidence 4 of 9.
chapters.howToStart: Paradigm Shipping poster in raid, or Intelligence Center 3 radio distress signal.

steps.title: Start Boreas: poster in raid, or Intel Center 3 radio
steps.detail: Either a Paradigm Shipping poster or the distress signal at Intelligence Center 3.

steps.title: Ask Mechanic about Paradigm Shipping / the distress signal
steps.detail: Trader screen.

steps.title: Woods: repair the gear under the cellular tower (Toolset)
steps.detail: Scav bunker on Woods. The repair consumes a Toolset. Then report to Mechanic.

steps.title: Lighthouse: Paradigm Shipping directive in the north freight warehouse
steps.detail: On the table next to the lamp. Tell Mechanic about Boreas.

steps.title: Pay Prapor (AMG-10 hydraulic fluid) and finish the BTR driver's tasks
steps.detail: Quest-item AMG-10 only, six Reserve spawns (black-bishop basement and parade helicopter). If you kept the Falling Skies case, Prapor also wants 3 FiR military power filters. Then the BTR line — do not pick Choose Your Friends Wisely if you still need 0.4 for Savior.

steps.title: Board the Shoreline hovercraft (bring fare and a way back)
steps.detail: Pier on Shoreline. Optional: 400,000 RUB in, green flare + 2,500 EUR out. Without the return kit you are stuck on the ship.

steps.title: Icebreaker: engine room, SZ-1 chained door, code 312220, thaw the hatch
steps.detail: Ask Mechanic then Prapor to unlock SZ-1 at LL1. Wedge squad + teargas tripwire in crew quarters. Scientist on level-1 east intercom. Plant Labs server-room hacker if Blue Fire did not already. Code 3-1-2-2-2-0 never changes. BBQ-S43 torch in the level-3 kitchen.

steps.title: Compartment C-1: three hard drives, then Mechanic's decode materials
steps.detail: C-1 keycard in a level-9 body's left hand. Drives: left shelves, under the desk, on the servers. Hand Mechanic 3 Ultralink modules, 4 server RAM, 2 cryptographic processors, all FiR (lootable on the ship).

steps.title: MAJOR EVIDENCE: Icebreaker archive data arrives in the mail
steps.detail: Read it from the Handbook after Mechanic finishes the decode. Then BTR Driver: 20 icebreaker kills and 5 respirators (Hangover) to close the chapter.

chapters.name: The Labyrinth
chapters.summary: Knossos underground under the Shoreline resort. Ends with the facility research report in a Shoreline pier drain — major evidence 5 of 9.
chapters.howToStart: Shoreline resort west-wing basement. Needs the Knossos LLC facility key. Ask Jaeger.

steps.title: Ask Jaeger about the underground facility, wait 12–24h for Labrys cards
steps.detail: He wants info on the missing BEAR squad. Optional: ask Therapist. He then mails two Labrys access keycards.

steps.title: Shoreline west-wing basement: Labyrinth transit (Knossos key)
steps.detail: Jaeger mails Labrys keycards after 12–24 hours. The Labyrinth transit is in the Shoreline health-resort west-wing basement and needs the Knossos key.

steps.title: Clear your spawn chamber, then the BEAR traces
steps.detail: Five hazard chambers (toxic, steam, fire, shotgun, puddle). Leshy's orders in a food container in front of chamber 2. Prototype-weapon area is the regroup. Squad leader is in the torture room with Leshy's diary.

steps.title: Five lab-staff bodies + observation-room tape, then hand the tape to Jaeger
steps.detail: Pick up the note on each of five lab-staff bodies. Body 4 is behind the observation-room door and needs the Observation room key. The audio tape is in that office — hand it to Jaeger.
steps.location: Five scientist bodies; body 4 is in the observation room

steps.title: MAJOR EVIDENCE: Labyrinth facility report in the Shoreline pier drain
steps.detail: Not inside the Labyrinth. Drain pipe next to the Shoreline pier. Read it. Unlocks Theseus.

chapters.name: The Unheard
chapters.summary: Purification notes, Factory catalyst, A.P.'s apartment. Two major pieces: Warden document and fuel-catalyst report.
chapters.howToStart: Note with ramblings about the Purification: Streets TG security/office, or Ground Zero office 4 (level 21+, science office key).

steps.title: Read the Purification note to start the chapter
steps.detail: Read the Purification note. Streets: surveillance room inside the TerraGroup security post. Ground Zero (level 21+): office 4, second floor of the TerraGroup building — TerraGroup science office key. Either spawn starts the chapter.
steps.location: TerraGroup security post surveillance room on Streets, or TerraGroup science office 4 on Ground Zero (level 21+)

steps.title: Labs: document on enterprise interactions + cargo fax
steps.detail: Enterprise doc: lab next to the dome, first floor, beside the screen. Cargo fax: office O23, second floor, lowboard next to the safe.

steps.title: Factory: transport log on the yellow barrel by the floor hole
steps.detail: Pick up and read the transport log on the yellow barrel next to the hole in the Factory floor.
steps.location: Yellow barrel by the hole in the floor, Factory

steps.title: Streets: Rzhevsky's car hard drive, then Intel Center printout
steps.detail: The car is by the LexOs dealership on Streets. Take the hard drive from the centre console, then craft the printout at Intelligence Center 1 (power must stay on) and read it.
steps.location: Rzhevsky's car by LexOs — hard drive on the centre console

steps.title: MAJOR EVIDENCE: fuel catalyst report in Factory TG storage
steps.detail: Underground tunnels, next to Camera Bunker Door scav extract. Needs TerraGroup storage room keycard. Report: bookshelf by the door, or the safe. Also grab the burnt document (table or right metal shelf).

steps.title: Labs: A.P. whiteboard + two lecture-room tapes
steps.detail: Whiteboard in O23 or admin R22. Tapes in the lecture room (stairs, and a desk by a laptop).

steps.title: Shoreline east wing 305: A.P. flash drive and corporate apartment key
steps.detail: Optional first: Guard post note on the first floor of the west wing, desk by the southern security room — it names the room. A.P.'s flash drive and the corporate apartment key are in east wing 305. Decrypt the Sliderkey at Intelligence Center 1, then pay Mechanic 5,000,000 roubles to integrate it.
steps.location: Health Resort east wing room 305. Room number is on the west-wing guard desk note.

steps.title: Craft the GREEN A.P. apartment keycard (blue/red are fakes)
steps.detail: Craft the green Reprogrammed keycard for A.P.'s apartment at Intelligence Center 1. The blue and red cards are false leads and do not open the hidden room.

steps.title: MAJOR EVIDENCE: Warden document in A.P.'s hidden office
steps.detail: Cardinal apartments, 2F apartment 1, Streets. Corporate apartment key on the front door, green keycard on the hidden room down the hall. Four docs: Worldwide order on the floor, TG Worldwide copy left desk, protocol on the pile, Warden document right desk. Read all four.

chapters.name: They Are Already Here
chapters.summary: Cultists and ARRS Station 14-4. Reset the station BEFORE taking the flash drive or you lose major evidence 8 of 9.
chapters.howToStart: Note about the Eye of the World: Customs dorm 314, Reserve marked rooms, Woods north village circle, or Shoreline island house.

steps.title: Read the Eye of the World note to start the chapter
steps.detail: Customs 3-storey dorm marked room (314 key); Reserve RB-BK / RB-VO / RB-PKPM; Woods north dilapidated village marked circle; or Shoreline island house floor.

steps.title: Lighthouse torture house: listen to tape #2, grab the apartment key
steps.detail: Listen to tape #2 in the torture house. The Cult victim's apartment key can spawn in this house and opens the Streets apartment.

steps.title: Streets: victim apartment 5 — Book of the Arrival, prep note, tape #1
steps.detail: Old apartment building behind Klimov, third floor, apartment 5. Needs the Cult victim's apartment key (also found in the Lighthouse torture house). Breach or unlock, then read two notes and listen to audio tape #1 in the office. The Book of the Arrival is here.
steps.location: Third floor, old apartments behind Klimov mall, apartment 5

steps.title: Ask Mechanic, kill a Cultist priest, read the priest note
steps.detail: Priest note only spawns after the priest is dead, in one marked room: Customs 3-storey 3F, Streets northern abandoned factory 3F, or Reserve RB-BK / PKPM / VO.

steps.title: Eye marks: Lighthouse blue chalet + Woods north village + Shoreline Sordi tower
steps.detail: Lighthouse: small southern bedroom 2F northern blue chalet; damaged 14-4 KORD pass on an ATV by the garage. Woods: newspaper clipping on a whiteboard. Shoreline: red shack at the radio tower near Road to Customs — Programmer's note in a body's right hand, repair inside consumes a Toolset.

steps.title: Ask Mechanic again, craft the restored 14-4 KORD pass
steps.detail: Intelligence Center 1. Power must stay on.

steps.title: Interchange power-station basement: restore power, cooling, plant a flash drive
steps.detail: NGO Cobalt / ARRS 14-4. Swipe the restored pass at the panel inside. Cooling lever at the back of the grated server room. Secure flash drive to the left of that lever. Listen to the tape in the entrance safe once cooling is on. Extract Survived or Run-Through.

steps.title: Return: read mechanic notes, restore backup, THEN take the flash drive
steps.detail: Power on again. Button under the server-room table — one player per raid. Flash drive for ARRS is on the server next to the cooling lever. Reset first or you permanently miss the ARRS specs. Extract again, hand the drive to Mechanic, read the specs in the Handbook.

steps.title: MAJOR EVIDENCE: ARRS system specifications (mail / Handbook)
steps.detail: Major evidence is the ARRS specification, delivered by mail after you extract with the flash drive. Do not take the drive before restoring the station to backup settings, or the evidence is blank.
steps.location: ARRS station 14-4 KORD, Interchange — flash drive after the backup reset

chapters.name: Ms. A. transcript
chapters.summary: No story chapter. Cardinal apartment safe plus Labs Black. This is the free extra so you can miss one other chapter and still hit 8 of 9. Do not skip it.
chapters.howToStart: Cardinal apartment on Streets. Labs Black keycard opens the safe.

steps.title: Get Cardinal apartment key and Labs Black keycard
steps.detail: Both are required. Black is also used later to activate Kruglov's RFID on the Savior path.

steps.title: MAJOR EVIDENCE: Ms. A. conversation transcript in Cardinal's safe
steps.detail: Open the Cardinal apartment safe with Labs Black. Read the transcript. Do not skip this piece.
